verdict.rationale: pnpm documents an offline-capable install mode that uses only packages already in the store (pnpm-docs-10). It has a dedicated CI page with frozen-lockfile behavior (pnpm-docs-13) and a content-addressable store that suits caching (pnpm-docs-15). Hands-on reports describe much faster CI installs and a smaller cache (pnpm-comm-5), plus third-party zero-config caching support (pnpm-comm-9). However, no cited evidence shows a documented cache-restore recipe, such as caching the store directory between CI runs. Missing for 10: a documented CI cache-restore setup (store path caching or a cache-key example), and independent corroboration of offline installs working in CI.
